reports.title: 2026 Report to the Chelmsford Select Board
reports.summary: Final season report: 2,359 lbs and $5,982 of fresh produce donated — the program's largest harvest on record, up 18% by weight over 2025.

reports.title: 2025 Season Report
reports.summary: The baseline season: 1,993 lbs and $4,824 of fresh produce from 35 donors across 43 varieties — the first fully recorded Grow-a-Row season.
